title: General knowledge — Intelligence
text:
Title: General knowledge — Intelligence

High scorers on tests of general knowledge tend to also score highly on intelligence tests. IQ has been found to robustly predict general knowledge scores 
even after accounting for differences in age, and five-factor model personality traits. However, many general knowledge tests are designed to create '
a normal distribution of answers, creating a bell-shaped curve. General knowledge is also moderately associated with verbal ability, though only weakly or not at all with numerical and spatial ability. As with crystallized intelligence, general knowledge has been found to increase with age.
